title: WooCommerce Troubleshooting
description: Fix checkout failures, payment gateway errors, cart session issues, and Action Scheduler backlog problems.

steps.title: Identify Broken Store Flow
steps.instructions: Pinpoint where it fails: add to cart, cart page, checkout fields, payment, order confirmation email, or my-account. Note any JS errors on checkout.

steps.title: Review WooCommerce System Status
steps.instructions: Open WooCommerce → Status and fix red/yellow items: pages missing, outdated templates, SSL, geolocation, or background processing warnings.

steps.title: Clear Action Scheduler Backlog
steps.instructions: Check WooCommerce → Status → Scheduled Actions for failed or pending hooks. Clear stuck batches and ensure WP-Cron or server cron is running.

steps.title: Exclude Cart, Checkout, and Account from Cache
steps.instructions: Page cache must not cache cart/checkout or logged-in sessions. Add WooCommerce cookies to cache bypass rules and purge cache after testing.

steps.title: Debug Payment Gateway Errors
steps.instructions: Enable gateway debug/logging (Stripe, PayPal, etc.). Verify API keys, webhooks, and test mode vs live mode. Check for SSL and currency mismatches.

steps.title: Resolve Theme Template Overrides
steps.instructions: Outdated woocommerce/ templates in the theme break checkout after WC updates. Compare with WooCommerce → Status → Templates and update overrides.

steps.title: Test for Plugin Conflicts
steps.instructions: Deactivate nonessential plugins on staging. Common conflicts: cache, minify, currency switchers, and custom checkout field plugins.

steps.title: Place Test Order and Verify Emails
steps.instructions: Complete a full test purchase (gateway test mode). Confirm order in admin, customer email, and stock reduction. Document fix for client runbook.
